initialValidation.scope: Synthetic tests before narrow alias correction; not device evidence.

resolvedFinding.before: BuiltInKeyboardId=-2 plus raw-2 aka0 annotation could resolve reader0 to NO_BUILT_IN_KEYBOARD and be recorded.
resolvedFinding.after: Alias predicate requires built_in>=0, and raw0 mapping independently requires built_in>=0.

reviewedContracts: Native/manager/EventHub/Reader/blocker/dispatcher/Java section ordering and uniqueness prevent cross-subsystem field reuse.
Reader declared device count, duplicate logical/raw IDs and duplicate selected fields reject ambiguous inventories.
Explicit EventHub Devices mapping supports multiple raw nodes for one reader and prevents one raw node from being silently reused by multiple readers.
Built-in0 alias resolves only through nonnegative configured actualraw ID; negative virtual IDs remain distinct from IsVirtualDevice.
Reader keyboardType and EventHub enabled/classes are captured as capabilities; qwerty/hardKeyboardHidden are explicitly not printed and not inferred.
Original bytes and selected subsection hashes retained includingCRLF; complete command/error/truncation limits remain caller requirements.
Unparsed descriptor/path/driver/configuration metadata remain in original dump, not newly claimed derived identity.
InputReader/EventHub snapshot does not attest identical device topology across both experiment arms or establish AVD runtime causation.
